project.name: Portfolio Review Desk
project.goal: Every week, produce a recommended book for my own account and the case for each change. One row per position: instrument, direction, weight, a one-sentence thesis, the risk manager's approved limit, the invalidation level or date, and the review date. Beside it, every change since last week with its reason — additions, exits and resizes each get a line. Every recommendation passes risk review before it reaches me, and a rejection with its arithmetic is a complete deliverable. Maintain an attribution file: what each position contributed, whether the thesis or the market moved it, and which calls were right for the wrong reason. This desk RECOMMENDS ONLY. It never places, modifies or cancels an order and never touches a brokerage credential — I execute every move myself.
